title: lmdb: map_size_gb as usize can silently truncate before checked_mul
description: LmdbBlockDb::open casts map_size_gb (u64) to usize before checked_mul. On 32-bit platforms usize is 32 bits, so the cast itself can truncate before the overflow check runs. The check then passes on a truncated (too-small) value. Should check the cast separately with u64::try_into::<usize>().
